fact: Car 6 Allegedly left a gap of more than 10 lengths whilst behind the Safety Car
offence: Alleged breach of Article B5.13.2 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. It was noted that at a previous event (Canada 2025) Race Control had advised that in the interests of safety it would allow a certain degree of tolerance in relation to such alleged breaches, as drivers were required to prepare tyres and power units. Accordingly no further action is taken.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 6 Alleged Safety Car Infringement
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
